GvNzl0zo6Vk.title: Erigaisi Knocks Out Aronian With a Brilliant Tactic!!
GvNzl0zo6Vk.description:
Featured is an excellent chess game between Levon Aronian and Arjun Erigaisi from Round 5 of the 2025 FIDE World Cup. Out of the Italian Game, Erigaisi slowly and steadily outmaneuvers Aronian. By move 19, Erigaisi has a superior structure, and Aronian’s isolated d4-pawn must constantly be guarded by his pieces. Erigaisi’s kingside knight outposts are particularly instructive and coordinate beautifully with the f8-rook on f3, ready to pounce at the right moment. He misses one strong opportunity on move 33, but fully redeems himself with a brilliant tactic only a few moves later, forcing Aronian to resign on the spot.
#FIDEWorldCup #LevonAronian #ArjunErigaisi
